notes.title: Tower Menu controls updated
notes.notes: This was one of the most requested fixes, the tower menu wheel was not behaving as expected, so I changed it so you can point with the mouse the tower you want to build.

notes.title: Lots of small changes
notes.notes: I've done some balancing, I think I won't do anymore in a while. Also more fixes to the reward system, I think it is now perfect. Also some visual upgrades. I guess this is it, I need to start taking notes of what I change.

notes.title: First bug fix
notes.notes: Noticed the towers being saved were retrieved as a different type, all good now

notes.title: Some more balancing
notes.notes:
After I saw a video on youtube I noticed a few problems like balancing, menu interaction and also some post effects issues.
So now the first few levels are easier to win, and bugs have been fixed.
Please join our discord so I can hear your opinion!

notes.title: Weaker enemies
notes.notes: I have recently come accross someone playing it and found out it was too hard, so this is a quick fix but should probably be updated soon
